findings.detail: The CAD marker belongs to the Principal / Shares cell for Spruce Bidco II Inc.; the flagged cost value is in the separate Cost (2) column and should not inherit CAD as cost_currency.
The JPY marker belongs to the Principal / Shares cell for Spruce Bidco II Inc.; the flagged cost value is in the separate Cost (2) column and should not inherit JPY as cost_currency.

rationale: FX03 is a within-row currency localization issue. The source table header separates Principal / Shares from Cost (2), and the only CAD/JPY text appears in the Principal / Shares cells on rows 28 and 30. The cost cells for those same rows are separate numeric cells, so storing cost_currency as U_CAD and U_JPY is a real extraction/localization error.
